model: Spidey and His Amazing Friends Tricycle
description:
The Huffy Spidey & His Amazing Friends Tricycle brings superhero excitement to every ride with bold Spidey graphics and colorful styling. Designed for kids ages 3 and up, this kids tricycle encourages active outdoor play and imaginative adventures.
A stable three-wheel design and comfortable bucket seat help young riders build balance and confidence as they learn to pedal and steer. The durable steel frame is made for everyday adventures, while the easy-grip seat handle adds extra comfort and support.
A convenient rear storage bin lets little heroes bring toys and treasures along for every mission. Whether exploring the neighborhood or imagining action-packed rescues, this Spidey tricycle is built for fun that grows with every ride.
